ZentisRefRegistry.note: oracle band disabled (FEED = address(0)): Arbitrum Sepolia has no standard ETH/USD Data Feed, only Data Streams. Redeployed so the on-chain bytecode matches the repository: the superseded instance predates the fix that makes onReport reject rather than revert.

ZentisRouter.note: Shares an address with Base Sepolia's ZentisRefRegistry: same deployer, same nonce, different chains. Different contracts -- do not confuse them.

position.note: Same positionId as Base Sepolia, different strategyHash -- the chainSalt is what separates the two legs of one cross-chain position.

crossChainEffect.claim: A fill on Base moves the Arbitrum quote, with no Arbitrum transaction in between and no bridging.
crossChainEffect.note: Between the two quotes the only Arbitrum state that changed is the reference. Arbitrum is now the under-weight-USDC leg, so it pays takers more WETH for their USDC -- it bids USDC in, while Base discounts USDC out. Inventory moves between the chains through independent takers.

supersededPosition.note: Docked when the registry was redeployed. Its fills are real and still on-chain; it read the superseded registry, whose address is an instruction immediate, so it could not follow the redeploy.
